## **KPH40/Retro** ****


**Rediscover the Golden Age of Sound** ****


KPH40/Retro delivers a timeless audio experience rooted in over 65 years of sound innovation and design only Koss can deliver.


Enjoy incredibly spacious, detailed high-fidelity audio with an ultra-wide


15-25,000 Hz frequency response


, bringing your music to life with unmatched depth, bass response and detail you have to hear to believe.


[Shop Now](https://koss.com/kph40-retro)


## **Real. Retro. Soul.**


**The Sound of Koss**


**** A lightweight, ultra durable


stainless-steel headband


inspired by Koss classics like the P/19 and KFF/100


paired with vivid orange cushions blends timeless styling with modern comfort, creating a bold, nostalgic look that stands out in a world of ordinary headphones.


## **Legendary Look. Legendary Sound.**


**15-25,000 Hz**


**** 60 Ohm dynamic drivers deliver breathtaking high-fidelity audio with rich, detailed sound, deep bass, and a superior midrange,


all backed by the Koss Limited Lifetime Warranty.


Timeless design. Legendary sound. Tuned for today.


## **Timeless Sound. Timeless Design.**


**Hearing is Believing**


**** At just $29.99 KPH40/Retro delivers unmatched sound and unmistakable style in one of the most accessible dynamic on-ear headphones we've ever designed.


KPH40/Retro is available today at Koss.com and our Amazon storefront.


[Shop Now](https://koss.com/kph40-retro)
